prompt:
A desktop web app screen for Hive, a team workspace where people chat in channels and one shared AI agent, Hive, does tasks on its own computer. Edge to edge, crisp readable text, no browser window or device. The three references are style only, never content: the first two are Linear's product (flat near-black surfaces, three greys of text, hairline dividers, tiny status icons, small flat chips), the third is Slack (shell construction: an icon rail with small labels inside a coloured chrome frame around the work area). Copy no Linear or Slack content or branding.
Shell: far-left icon rail with icons and small labels (Chat, Activity, Ideas, Goals, Apps, Calendar, Files; at the bottom Computer and the user avatar), Hive's small cartoon bee logo at the top. Channel sidebar as a plain text list: workspace 'Fern & Fig' with a chevron, a 'Hive' row, CHANNELS: launch (active, 2 unread), design, ops, hiring; THREADS: 'Launch email subject lines', 'Carrier comparison'. Main area header '# launch', '6 members', and 'Computer · online'. Chat: Priya 10:24 'Photos are in. The hero for the email is the maidenhair fern.' Marcus 10:31 '@hive what do we still need before the send?' Hive (small bee avatar, 'Agent' label) replies with four lines, each a task name with a tiny status icon and small chip: 'Write the launch email' Needs review, 'Schedule the launch send' Blocked, 'Set up the pre-order page' Running, 'Order 8-inch boxes' Failed. Below, one flat agent task item: chip 'Needs your review', title 'Write the launch email', grey meta 'Agent · Due Fri', a dim collapsed line 'Worked for 18 minutes ▸', buttons 'Mark done' and 'Send back'. Flat message composer at the bottom with a send button.
Colour jobs: honey #F2B632 only for what needs a person (the Needs review chips, the task item's left edge, the send button); sage #7FAE92 for Running and online; muted red for Failed; grey for Blocked. No shadows, no glass, no blur, no gradients.
Look: pure Linear. Everything is near-black with a faint green cast (#0E1110 ground, #121514 sidebar, hairlines #1F2422), rail, sidebar and chat edge to edge separated only by hairlines. Green lives only in the ground's cast and the active channel row (#18231D). Quiet, dense, serious.
